jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 중개사무소 lane `real-estate-broker-office` (root ADR-0169 ③, ADR-0511 §4): pick the newest daily national AL_D171 object, read from the ZIP members measured beside the Bronze ledger, and, unless silver.real_estate_broker_office already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows 시도 by 시도 and append to main only the changed offices' rows and a removal marker per closed office (keyed by 시군구 and 등록번호; lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0311, ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

first_run.estimated_from: computed, on the same template unit (root ADR-0386): silver_refresh_building_permit_demolition_loss 161 s for a 15 MB release and _parking 251 s for 59 MB; this lane's newest object is 5.3 MB (23 MB unzipped, 106,429 rows) in R2 (2026-11-11), and its compare splits into 17 시도 buckets

expected_outcome.basis: the provider publishes a new national file every day (expected_cadence daily, max_age_hours 72, in the endpoint catalog; one per day 2026-10-28..11-09 in the Bronze ledger) and offices register and close every day; this lane has not run yet, so its first change is its first load (root ADR-0457).

assets.title: 중개사무소 등록
assets.description: 시군구가 등록한 중개사무소마다 한 행: 등록번호·사업자상호·대표 중개업자명·상태(영업중·휴업·업무정지·휴업연장)·등록일자·보증설정 기간·지번/도로명 주소. 키는 (시군구, 등록번호). 매일 오는 전국 파일에서 바뀐 사무소만 덧붙이고 없어진 사무소엔 삭제 표시를 단다. 소비자(공짱 회원 가입의 중개사 확인 조회)가 서기 전까지 contract_only 다(루트 ADR-0511 §4).

dependencies.description: AL_D171 CSV 15칸만 연결한다. 같은 원천의 소속 인원 AL_D172 는 자기 레인, 위치 AL_D170 SHP 는 Bronze 에 남는다. 따옴표 안 쉼표는 RFC 4180 으로 한 칸이다.
